title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) out against Jaguars on Thursday night
items.desc: Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) is out against the Jaguars on Thursday night.
items.impact: With Hawkins out, Keondre Jackson will step up into the starting role. For those who are in IDP leagues, Jackson offers little upside, but could be a worthwhile fill-in if desperate.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle) active for Thursday Night Football
items.desc: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle) is active for the Jaguars Thursday Night Football contest against the Ravens.
items.impact: Fire up the Jaguars RB1, who has been on a hot streak coming into this game and should have ample opportunity to put up points in what should be a blowout.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: David Bailey (groin) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: David Bailey (groin) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Bailey was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday. A groin injury left him limited on Wednesday, but it's not a serious issue at this point and shouldn't affect his availability for Week 9. New York's defensive front will be stronger with him likely available to play.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Watson (rib) limited in practice Thursday
items.desc: Christian Watson remained limited in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Watson is continuing to trend towards being good to go for Sunday's game against the Patriots.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) added to injury report Thursday
items.desc: Harold Fannin Jr. was limited in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Fannin was added to the injury report. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Huntley (toe) placed on IR
items.desc: The Ravens placed Tyler Huntley on injured reserve.
items.impact: Huntley is expected to miss the rest of the season with his turf toe injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Lamar Jackson (thumb) officially placed on IR
items.desc: The Ravens placed Lamar Jackson on injured reserve.
items.impact: Jackson is expected to require surgery on his thumb injury. His status to return this season remains up in the air.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Barmore (illness) back at practice Thursday
items.desc: Christian Barmore returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Barmore did not practice to begin the week on Wednesday due to an illness. He should be good to go for Sunday's game against the Packers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Morgan Moses (foot) practices Thursday
items.desc: Morgan Moses practiced again on Thursday.
items.impact: Moses was limited in practice on Wednesday to begin the week. He should be trending towards playing.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marcus Jones not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Marcus Jones did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Jones was not on the injury report on Wednesday. He'll need to be monitored when Thursday's injury report is released.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Hunter Henry (foot) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Hunter Henry did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Henry sat out of practice for the second straight day. He'll likely have to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to play in Week 9.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson remained absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Henderson is continuing to trend towards missing another game for the Patriots. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday to end the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: A.J. Brown did not practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Brown is continuing to trend towards missing another game for the Patriots. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday to end the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Charvarius Ward Sr. returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Charvarius Ward Sr. was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Ward got a rest day from practice on Wednesday. He'll be good to go for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jonathan Taylor logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Jonathan Taylor was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Taylor was upgraded after he was limited in practice on Wednesday. He is slated to play at least one more game with the Colts before a potential trade happens next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Anthony Gould (concussion) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Anthony Gould was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Gould logged his second straight full practice while he remains in concussion protocol. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Akeem Davis-Gaither (knee) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Akeem Davis-Gaither missed practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Davis-Gaither will likely have to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to play in Week 9.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Keenan Allen returns to practice on Thursday
items.desc: Keenan Allen was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Allen got a rest day to begin the week on Wednesday. He remains a fringe WR3/WR4 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) practices Thursday
items.desc: Jordyn Tyson practiced again on Thursday.
items.impact: Tyson was limited on Wednesday as he made his return to practice. It is unclear if he'll be activated by the Saints this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) practices Thursday
items.desc: Alvin Kamara returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Kamara missed practice on Wednesday. He'll need to be monitored on the official injury report for New Orleans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mason Taylor (back) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Mason Taylor (back) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Taylor was able to log a full practice session on Thursday, which was an upgrade after being limited on Wednesday due to a back issue. He should play in Week 9 but isn't expected to be a consistent fantasy asset moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Breece Hall (quad) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Hall was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday after being limited on Wednesday. He told reporters that he will be ready to play in Week 9, so fantasy managers should expect to see him out on the field on Sunday, barring any unforeseen setbacks between now and then.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) seen practicing Thursday
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) was seen participating at San Francisco's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: McCaffrey was not able to practice on Wednesday due to a hamstring issue that he's managing, but he was back and participating at the team's practice on Thursday. That's a great sign for his Week 9 availability, and we should get more information sometime after practice.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) did not take part in Chicago's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Monangai has already been sidelined for several weeks due to a pair of issues that he's dealing with, and he wasn't able to practice on Thursday as a result. He seems unlikely to play in Week 9, which will leave Roschon Johnson as Chicago's Rb2 behind D'Andre Swift for another game.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Caleb Downs (concussion/ankle) practices Thursday
items.desc: Caleb Downs practiced on Thursday.
items.impact: Downs missed practice to begin the week on Wednesday. He'll likely be listed as a limited participant on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: P.J. Locke (concussion) practices Thursday
items.desc: P.J. Locke got in some work in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Locke remains in concussion protocol. He will likely be limited in practice.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jihaad Campbell (hamstring/quad) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Jihaad Campbell did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Campbell continues to battle multiple injuries. His status for Sunday's game against the Giants is up in the air.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Britain Covey not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Britain Covey is not practicing on Thursday.

items.title: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Dontayvion Wicks remained absent from practice on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: DeVonta Smith is not practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Smith is continuing to trend in the wrong direction to return for Sunday's game against the Giants.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Saquon Barkley practicing Thursday
items.desc: Saquon Barkley is practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Barkley is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against his former team in the Giants. He'll remain on the RB2 radar for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zavier Scott (thumb) placed on IR
items.desc: The Bears placed RB Zavier Scott on injured reserve.
items.impact: Scott has been playing a role on special teams. He'll miss at least the next four weeks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) working on side with trainer in practice Thursday
items.desc: Cam Skattebo was working with trainers on the side during practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Skattebo will likely be listed as a non-participant in practice again on Thursday. His status for Week 9 is uncertain.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Deshaun Watson (concussion) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Deshaun Watson remained absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Watson remains in concussion protocol. He is continuing to trend in the wrong direction for Sunday's game against the Saints.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyler Murray (hamstring) week-to-week
items.desc: Kyler Murray is considered week-to-week with his hamstring injury.
items.impact: Carson Wentz was named the Vikings starter for Monday's game against the Bills. Murray could become the backup for Minnesota if Wentz plays well.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Malik Nabers works off to side with trainers during practice Thursday
items.desc: Malik Nabers was seen working off to the side with trainers on Thursday.
items.impact: It is unclear what Nabers is dealing with. He will need to be monitored when the injury report for Thursday is released.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylen Wright (quad) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Jaylen Wright was back at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Wright remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Garrett Wilson (concussion) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Garrett Wilson was not seen practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Wilson continues to trend in the wrong direction to play this week as he remains in concussion protocol.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carson Wentz will start in Week 9 for Vikings
items.desc: Carson Wentz will start Monday's game against the Bills.
items.impact: Kyler Murray is continuing to battle a sore hamstring. Wentz will be a QB2 for fantasy managers in 2-QB and superflex leagues.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kader Kohou signs with Bills
items.desc: The Bills signed CB Kader Kohou to their practice squad.
items.impact: Kohou previously spent time with the Dolphins. He'll remain in the AFC East.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: KhaDarel Hodge expected to be available Sunday
items.desc: KhaDarel Hodge is expected to be available for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
items.impact: The 49ers are still expected to be without Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel. It will be Hodge, Demarcus Robinson, Christian Kirk, Jordan Watkins, and Brandin Cooks leading the wide receiver room for San Francisco.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Demarcus Robinson (ankle) expected to play Sunday
items.desc: Demarcus Robinson is expected to be available for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
items.impact: The 49ers are still expected to be without Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel. Robinson, Christian Kirk, Jordan Watkins, and Brandin Cooks will lead the 49ers wide receiver room.

items.title: DJ Turner II (heel) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: DJ Turner II was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Turner will be good to go for Sunday's game against the Falcons.
